# Aape Mel Milaye

Official website: https://aapemelmilaye.com/

Aape Mel Milaye is a non-profit community matrimonial service for Sindhi, Punjabi and Sikh families in India.

The website allows families to submit matrimonial profiles through a Google Form. Approved members can log in to view candidate profiles. Candidate contact details are not publicly displayed on the website and are shared only through the admin contact process.

Primary communities served:
- Sindhi matrimonial profiles
- Punjabi matrimonial profiles
- Sikh matrimonial profiles

Important public pages:
- Homepage and registration: https://aapemelmilaye.com/

Admin/contact:
- Mr. T.S. Bedi
- Phone/WhatsApp: +91-9407851953

Privacy note:
Candidate profile details are visible only to approved members after login. Candidate phone numbers, WhatsApp numbers and addresses are not shown publicly.
